title: Pan-Seared Broccoli with Shattering Crust
description: A French-inspired dish featuring a crunchy shattering topping and tender broccoli, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Rinse the broccoli and trim the ends. Cut into florets.
In a bowl, toss the broccoli with olive oil, salt, pepper, and minced garlic.
Transfer the broccoli to a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
While the broccoli is roasting, mix the crushed shattering and chopped Arabian hash in a small bowl.
Remove the broccoli from the oven and sprinkle the shattering mixture on top.
Return the broccoli to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
